question: Should this release remove the 37 shipped root skills and make Sherpa ONNX TTS an official ClawHub-only plugin, and if so what upgrade contract must preserve existing configured users?
rationale: Code review can identify the break and trust boundaries, but only maintainers can approve the shipped deprecation set, supported migration behavior, and official package/artifact trust policy.

options.title: Migration-first trim
options.body: Approve the smaller starter set only after adding doctor/update migration, upgrade tests, package availability proof, and exact-head dependency and artifact approval.

options.title: Split Sherpa packaging
options.body: Land the Sherpa official-plugin and install-routing work separately while keeping the current bundled skill set until its deprecation plan is ready.

options.title: Accept a hard break
options.body: Deliberately ship the removals as a breaking release with explicit release notes and support ownership instead of automated migration.

recommendation.title: Migration-first trim
recommendation.body: Approve the smaller starter set only after adding doctor/update migration, upgrade tests, package availability proof, and exact-head dependency and artifact approval.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent split-work history, is assigned, and has framed the remaining product decision in the PR discussion.
